newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens weaker, Abbey Nat falls.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens weaker, Abbey Nat falls.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened mildly lower on Tuesday, depressed by first half earnings from Abbey National which set a weaker tone for the rest of the banking sector.
But losses were limited as the pound extended its slide against the German mark following a heavy bout of profit-taking on Monday, prompting gains in some overseas earners.
A firm opening for the September FTSE futures contract helped to drag the cash market back from its opening loss.
The lead index was up 1.2 points at 4,863.8 by 0742 GMT. Gainers outweighed decliners by four-to-three.
